proposals.evidence: All four constituents are represented: hunger + be felt + remain (progressive) + is. The roots are bubhukṣā, lagyati, *rahati and ākṣeti; the last explicitly includes Hindi hai and Gujarati che. Local voicing and vowel variation are retained, and fused spelling does not hide the auxiliary.
